notes.text: Dmitri Ivanovich Dmitri Mendeleev was a Russian chemist known for formulating the periodic law and creating a version of the periodic table of elements.

Dmitri Mendeleev used the periodic law not only to correct the then-accepted properties of some known elements, such as the valence and atomic weight of uranium, but also to predict the properties of three elements that were yet to be discovered.
Dmitri Mendeleev is remembered as a chemist connected with Russia.
Dmitri Mendeleev's recorded life dates place this profile around 1834-1907.
Dmitri Mendeleev is grouped with Science, Math & Technology in the People Library.
